name: Seaglass
description: A lush stereo reverb you can freeze: Freeze holds the sound as an endless pad and Add layers the next note on top, so you can build a frozen chord one note at a time, with the live reverb still playing beside it (Live); Shimmer pitch-shifts the tail up an octave (or a fifth, two octaves, or down an octave) inside the feedback loop so it rises and sparkles; Swell ducks the tail while you play and lets it bloom back in the gaps. 11 programs.
author: Groundswell
